All 12 tests pass.

`habit done <name> yesterday` and `habit done <name> YYYY-MM-DD` now work: `src/cli.js` splits a trailing date token off the args and resolves it via a new `resolveDoneDate` helper in `src/streak.js` (handles `today`, `yesterday`, `YYYY-MM-DD`, else falls back to treating the token as part of the name, unchanged from before). Added tests in `test/streak.test.js` and a new `test/cli.test.js` for end-to-end CLI behavior.

One thing worth deciding: an invalid date like `2026-13-40` currently falls back silently to being treated as part of the habit name rather than erroring — let me know if you'd rather it print an error instead.
